findings.claim: The new filter ReportIfLocatedInCompilation silently drops every diagnostic whose location is in a syntax tree outside the compilation, and GetPropertyIdentifierLocation now returns null for metadata symbols. This matches L8, which says a type from a referenced assembly is deliberately not analysed and that a missing diagnostic for it is not a defect. The README and MsgPack004 doc text saying such diagnostics belong to the defining assembly is consistent with L8, so it is not a problem.

receipt_plan.detail: [L8] Types from a referenced assembly are deliberately not analysed and a missing diagnostic or formatter for them is not a defect. The dropped diagnostics for metadata-only types are therefore intended.

findings.claim: The generated resolver for the consuming assembly may not include a formatter for the closed generic Item<int>. L11, L12 and L13 say to follow the requirement, which only asks for a clean build and a generated resolver, so the tests asserting only that the resolver hint name exists are acceptable.

receipt_plan.detail: [L11]/[L12]/[L13] No preference on whether a formatter is registered for the closed generic type from the referenced assembly. The requirement only demands a generated resolver, no crash and no warnings.
